## Checklist

- [ ] One change per PR, with a title that says what it does
- [ ] A line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md, or the `no-changelog` label
- [ ] Tests added or updated for logic changes in GadgetKit
- [ ] No real identifiers in code, tests, screenshots or logs (server addresses, device IDs, network names, keys)
- [ ] Docs updated, or the reason none apply is explained
